subject: Re: EIM status: suites reproduced, TF1-era code is the risk
body:
All,

Decisions for window close on Apr 13:

1. Shim-first it is. We froze the API on Mar 20 over the compat layer; the TF2 eager port of the core samplers becomes a Q2 line item. Consumers get a stable surface now and a faster backend later - that was the right trade.

2. Leaderboard: Nikhil's MVP is up internally with the small_problems and static_mnist boards populated. Scoring-worker re-runs are the slow part (~40 min per MNIST config), so v1 caps at nightly refresh rather than on-submit. Fine for launch.

3. Adoption OKR: one team onboarded, second in progress - we'll call it yellow at close and carry it two weeks into Q2 rather than rushing an integration nobody maintains.

Thanks all - tight quarter, good outcome. Retro invite coming for the week of the 13th.

Dmitri
